blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of the Visayas (UV) Green Lancers exacted revenge on the University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors with a 58-53 victory in their rematch in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday, November 14, at the Cebu Coliseum. The victory was crucial for UV’s bid to secure a twice-to-beat advantage in the Final Four. The defending champions improved to a 9-3 win-loss record, keeping them at No. 2 in the standings. USC, meanwhile, dropped to 9-5 after absorbing its fifth loss of the season.
